@@U02637@@
(Startled.)

@@U02638@@
The Mothers!

@@U02640@@
What’s that? Afraid?

@@U02642@@
The Mothers! The Mothers! It sounds so strange.

@@U02644@@
And s0 it is. Goddesses unknown to you mortals, and reluctantly named by us. Youll need to dig deep to reach them. It’s your fault we're having to do this.

@@U02646@@
Which way?

@@U02648@@
No way! To the unvisited, never to be visited; to the unsolicited, never to be solicited. Are you ready? You will find there neither lock nor bolt to constrain you; you will be driven about by solitude. Are desolation and solitude concepts you can grasp?

@@U02650@@
I dare say you might have spared me that! It smells of the witch’s kitchen of a long time past. The world was with me then, I had no choice; what I learned was nothing, and nothing is what I taught. If I spoke reasonably what I saw to be reasonable, the contradictions would have been twice as loud.
translation:
@@U02637@@
（吓了一跳。）

@@U02638@@
母亲们！

@@U02640@@
那是什么？害怕的？

@@U02642@@
母亲们！母亲们！听起来很奇怪。

@@U02644@@
s0 确实如此。你们凡人不认识的女神，却被我们勉强命名。您需要深入挖掘才能找到它们。我们不得不这样做是你的错。

@@U02646@@
哪条路？

@@U02648@@
没办法！对于未曾拜访过的人，永远不会被拜访过；对于不请自来的人，永远不要被请求。你准备好了吗？你会发现那里既没有锁也没有螺栓来限制你；你会被孤独所驱使。荒凉和孤独是你能理解的概念吗？

@@U02650@@
我敢说你可能不会让我这么做！弥漫着很久以前女巫厨房的味道。那时世界就在我身边，我别无选择；我所学到的什么都不是，我所教的也什么都不是。如果我合理地说我认为合理的话，矛盾就会加倍激烈。
